title: snapshot_hash
description: Hash of one panel group, sent about every snapshot_interval_ms. applied_seq is the highest pilot-command seq the client has processed (for logs). (client to server)

loose.description: Indicators compared value by value instead of through the hash (CRO-34): those with a tolerance, and those that are compared only while their unit is powered. Never written.

tolerance.description: The sims match while the values differ by no more than this.

context.description: 'unpowered' while the unit is off (value null): not compared.

amber.description: An indicator with a profile notice (CRO-40): a difference beyond the tolerance is one amber indicator_differs advisory with this message, never a desync.

message.description: amber items only: the text the pilots see when it differs.
